Fixed
- Gear sync now shows the server's actual reason when it fails, right in the Character window sync tray and in chat, instead of a generic message. Pairs with a website fix so first-time sign-ins no longer hit a 'character not linked' error — your character is created automatically on first sync.

v0.4.0 — Gear, mount & collection sync

Added
- Mount farm sync: /xrp mountsync (also runs as part of /xrp sync) syncs owned mounts and totem counts to your static.
- Batch gearset sync: /xrp gearsync syncs your saved gearsets for every tracked job in one pass.
- /xrp syncgear syncs only your currently equipped gear.
- Character window Gear Sync overlay — an FFXIV-native sync tray with gear, mount, and collection actions right on your Character window.
- Collection participant sync and a catalog ID resolver (/xrp resolve-ids).
- Split Clear overlay: /xrp split surfaces in-game run assignments for split-clear nights.

Needs a language pack.","Description":"Gubal Library hands the game pre-translated copies of its own text files, so the game draws another language itself, in its own font and its own layout. Your game installation is never modified.

It ships empty and belongs to no language: point it at a community language pack and the game speaks that language. You choose what gets translated and what stays English, part by part.

/gubal → Opens the settings window.
/gubal status → What is installed, what is being served, and whether it reached the game.
/gubal parts → Lists what the pack covers and what you have switched off.
/gubal check → Asks the publisher whether a newer pack exists.
/gubal usepack → Serves the installed pack, or stops serving it.
/gubal autoupdate → Fetches a newer pack while the game is starting.
/gubal debug on|off → Diagnostics for when a page or a font is not reaching the game.

A pack must match the patch you are running, and the game reads its text once at startup, so a change takes effect the next time you start the client.

Optional dialogue links open unlocked Unending Codex entries directly from NPC dialogue and cutscenes. Enable them in /gubal.
